articles.title_en: Using Macro Counterfactuals to Assess Plausibility: An Illustration using the 2001 Rebate MPCs
articles.title_cn: 使用宏观反事实评估合理性：以2001年退税边际消费倾向为例
articles.abstract_en: Macroeconomics has increasingly adopted tools from the applied micro ‘credibility revolution’ to estimate micro parameters that can inform macro questions. In this paper, we argue that researchers should take advantage of this confluence of micro and macro to take the credibility revolution one step further. We argue that researchers should assess the plausibility of the micro estimates and macro models by constructing macro counterfactuals for historical periods and comparing these counterfactuals with reasonable benchmarks. We illustrate this approach by conducting a case study of the 2001 US tax rebates, as well as briefly summarising four other applications of the methodology. In the 2001 rebate case, we calibrate a two-good, two-agent New Keynesian model with the leading estimates of the household marginal propensity to consume out of the rebates to construct a counterfactual path for non-durable goods consumption. The counterfactual path implies that without the tax rebate non-durable goods consumption spending would have fallen dramatically in the late summer and fall of 2001. Using forecasting regressions and other evidence, we argue that this counterfactual is implausible. When we investigate the source of the discrepancy, we find that the leading marginal-propensity-to-consume estimates are not representative of the response of total consumption.
articles.abstract_cn: 宏观经济学越来越多地采用应用微观‘可信度革命’的工具来估计可以为宏观问题提供信息的微观参数。在本文中，我们认为研究人员应利用微观与宏观的这种融合，将可信度革命再推进一步。我们认为，研究人员应通过为历史时期构建宏观反事实，并将这些反事实与合理的基准进行比较，来评估微观估计和宏观模型的合理性。我们通过对2001年美国退税进行案例研究来说明这种方法，并简要总结了该方法的其他四个应用。在2001年退税案例中，我们用家庭对退税的边际消费倾向的主要估计来校准一个两商品、两主体的新凯恩斯模型，以构建非耐用品消费的反事实路径。该反事实路径表明，如果没有税收退税，非耐用品消费支出在2001年夏末和秋季将大幅下降。利用预测回归和其他证据，我们认为这一反事实是不合理的。当我们调查差异的来源时，我们发现主要的边际消费倾向估计并不能代表总消费的反应。

articles.title_en: When Information is Not Enough: Evidence from a Centralised School Choice System
articles.title_cn: 当信息不足时：来自集中式学校选择系统的证据
articles.abstract_en: We implemented a large-scale randomised controlled trial encompassing 900 junior high schools in Ghana, a country with universal secondary school choice, to study whether providing students and parents with information on school characteristics and selection strategies improved outcomes in a centralised school selection mechanism. Information changed households’ preferences and the characteristics of schools to which they applied. Students gained admission to higher value-added schools, yet they were not more likely to matriculate on time or at all. Incomplete school information was not the only friction. Household shocks and inaccurate preference forecasting likely contributed to continued admission deviations.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在加纳开展了一项大规模随机对照试验，涵盖900所初中，该国实行普及中学选择制度，旨在研究向学生和家长提供关于学校特征和选择策略的信息是否能改善集中式学校选择机制中的结果。信息改变了家庭的偏好及其申请学校的特点。学生被更高增值学校录取，但他们按时入学或入学的可能性并未增加。学校信息不完整并非唯一的摩擦因素。家庭冲击和偏好预测不准确可能导致了持续的录取偏差。

articles.abstract_en: A secession movement is an uncertain process that evolves over time. We develop a simple theoretical framework in which regions use news to update their decisions to secede. Uncertainty and economies of scale are necessary conditions to observe ‘domino secessions’—sequential interdependent secessions. Empirically, we use geographically specific assets (state bonds) to assess how uncertainty and economies of scale influenced some slaveholding states’ decisions to secede from the United States in the 1860s. Uncertainty prevailed over the outcome of the secession movement with financial markets updating their priors on potential seceders at the election of Abraham Lincoln, but also every time a state seceded. We further document that financial markets priced in economies of scale to both state and federal debt.
articles.abstract_cn: 脱离运动是一个随时间演变的不确定过程。我们构建了一个简单的理论框架，在该框架中，各地区利用新闻来更新其脱离决策。不确定性和规模经济是观察到“多米诺骨牌式脱离”——即连续的、相互依存的脱离——的必要条件。在实证方面，我们利用地理上特定的资产（州债券）来评估不确定性和规模经济如何影响了一些蓄奴州在1860年决定脱离美国的决策。不确定性主导了脱离运动的结果，金融市场在亚伯拉罕·林肯当选时，以及每次有州脱离时，都会更新其对潜在脱离者的先验信念。我们进一步证明，金融市场将规模经济计入州债务和联邦债务的定价中。

articles.title_en: Gender-Specific Application Behaviour, Matching, and the Residual Gender Earnings Gap
articles.title_cn: 性别特定的申请行为、匹配与残余性别收入差距
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines how gender-specific application behaviour, firms’ hiring practices and flexibility demands relate to the gender earnings gap, using linked data from the German Job Vacancy Survey and administrative records. Women are less likely than men to apply to high-wage firms with high flexibility requirements, although their hiring chances are similar when they do. We show that compensating differentials for firms’ flexibility demands help explain the residual gender earnings gap. Among women, mothers experience the largest earnings penalties relative to men in jobs with high flexibility requirements.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用德国职位空缺调查与管理记录的关联数据，考察性别特定的申请行为、企业的招聘实践及灵活性要求如何与性别收入差距相关联。女性申请高工资且灵活性要求高的企业的可能性低于男性，尽管她们在申请时获得录用的机会相似。我们表明，对企业灵活性要求的补偿性差异有助于解释残余性别收入差距。在女性中，母亲在灵活性要求高的工作中相对于男性面临最大的收入惩罚。

articles.title_en: Counteracting Narratives: Evidence from An Online Experiment
articles.title_cn: 抵消叙事：来自在线实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Can people counteract biased narratives with subsequent information? Using an online experiment where counteracting may have the best odds by design, we investigate this question by first randomly assigning subjects to read different narratives that contain the same facts, and then offering them the opportunity to acquire and process balanced arguments. We document three main findings. First, subjects shift their attitudes towards the standpoint of the randomly assigned narrative, knowing that the narrative is slanted and randomly assigned. Second, the opportunity to read additional arguments does not prompt subjects to counteract the persuasion effects of the initial narratives. Third, when evaluating subsequent arguments, participants find arguments aligned with the randomly assigned narrative more convincing. These findings remain qualitatively similar in additional treatments where the balanced arguments are provided two weeks after initial exposure to narratives. Only when we replace these arguments with the exact opposing narratives that subjects do not initially see are they able to fully counteract the effects. Taken together, our results highlight the importance of balanced and complete exposure at the outset in counteracting the influence of biased narratives.
articles.abstract_cn: 人们能否用后续信息来抵消带有偏见的叙事？通过一项在线实验，其中抵消在设计上可能具有最佳机会，我们通过首先随机分配受试者阅读包含相同事实但不同叙事，然后给予他们获取和处理平衡论点的机会来研究这个问题。我们记录了三个主要发现。首先，受试者将其态度转向随机分配的叙事的立场，尽管知道该叙事是有倾向性的且是随机分配的。其次，阅读额外论点的机会并未促使受试者抵消初始叙事的说服效果。第三，在评估后续论点时，参与者发现与随机分配的叙事一致的论点更具说服力。这些发现在额外处理中定性相似，其中平衡论点在初次接触叙事两周后提供。只有当我们用受试者最初未看到的完全相反的叙事替换这些论点时，他们才能完全抵消这些效果。综合来看，我们的结果强调了在抵消偏见叙事影响时，初始阶段平衡和完整暴露的重要性。

articles.title_en: How Market Prices React to Information: Evidence from Binary Options Markets
articles.title_cn: 市场价格如何对信息作出反应：来自二元期权市场的证据
articles.abstract_en: Using a natural experiment setting in binary options markets, we compare the evolution of market prices in situations where the occurrence of public information shocks is contingent on knife-edge conditions and can be considered nearly random. We find that prices mostly react efficiently and quickly to information shocks, adjusting to the new fundamental value. Nonetheless, we observe a tendency for prices to initially under-react when the information shocks are large. This under-reaction is short-lived.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用二元期权市场中的自然实验设置，我们比较了在公共信息冲击的发生取决于临界条件且可视为近乎随机的情况下，市场价格的演变。我们发现，价格大多对信息冲击作出有效且迅速的反应，调整至新的基本面价值。尽管如此，我们观察到当信息冲击较大时，价格最初存在反应不足的倾向。这种反应不足是短暂的。

articles.title_en: Do the Long-term Unemployed Benefit from Automated Occupational Advice during Online Job Search?
articles.title_cn: 长期失业者是否从在线求职中的自动化职业建议中受益？
articles.abstract_en: In a randomised field experiment, we provide suggestions about suitable occupations to long-term unemployed job seekers. The suggestions are automatically generated, integrated in an online job search platform and fed into actual search queries. Effects on ‘reaching a cumulative earnings threshold’ and ‘finding a stable job’ are positive, large and are more pronounced for those who are longer unemployed. Treated individuals include more occupations in their search and find more jobs in recommended occupations.
articles.abstract_cn: 在一项随机实地实验中，我们向长期失业的求职者提供关于合适职业的建议。这些建议是自动生成的，集成在一个在线求职平台中，并输入到实际的搜索查询中。对“达到累计收入门槛”和“找到稳定工作”的影响是积极的、显著的，并且对于失业时间更长的人更为明显。接受处理的个体在其搜索中包含更多职业，并在推荐职业中找到更多工作。

articles.title_en: Do capital grants improve microenterprise productivity?
articles.title_cn: 资本补助能否提高微型企业生产率？
articles.abstract_en: Do capital grants improve microenterprise productivity? We use the lens of a production function to re-examine two previous randomised controlled trials that allocated capital to microenterprises. We find that productivity is higher for treated firms, and accounts for about 20%–30% of the revenue effects of capital grants. Although long-run estimates are noisy, point estimates indicate that these productivity effects are sustained six years after the grants. We explore possible mechanisms for this finding, and show that treatment tilts the asset composition towards durables with a higher-technology component: a result consistent with an important role for capital-embodied technology. Mediation analysis confirms that virtually all of the effect of treatment on productivity can be explained by the adoption of higher-technology durables.
articles.abstract_cn: 资本补助能否提高微型企业生产率？我们运用生产函数的视角，重新审视了两项先前将资本分配给微型企业的随机对照试验。我们发现，受处理企业的生产率更高，且这约占资本补助收入效应的20%–30%。尽管长期估计存在噪声，但点估计表明，这些生产率效应在补助发放六年后依然持续。我们探讨了这一发现的可能机制，并显示处理使资产构成向具有更高技术成分的耐用品倾斜：这一结果与资本体现技术的重要作用相一致。中介分析证实，处理对生产率的几乎所有影响都可以通过采用更高技术的耐用品来解释。

articles.title_en: Revisiting the Impact of Upstream Mergers with Downstream Complements and Substitutes
articles.title_cn: 重新审视上游合并对下游互补品与替代品的影响
articles.abstract_en: I examine how upstream mergers affect negotiated prices when suppliers bargain with a monopoly intermediary selling products to final consumers. Conventional wisdom holds that such transactions lower negotiated prices when the products are complements for consumers and raise them when they are substitutes. The idea is that consumer demand relationships carry over to upstream negotiations, where mergers between complements weaken the suppliers’ bargaining leverage, while mergers between substitutes strengthen it. I challenge this view, showing that it breaks down when the intermediary sells products beyond those of the merging suppliers. In such cases, the merging suppliers’ products may act as substitutes for the intermediary even if they are complements for consumers, or as complements for the intermediary even if they are substitutes for consumers. These findings show that upstream conglomerate mergers can raise prices without foreclosure or monopolisation and help explain buyer-specific price effects resulting from such mergers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了当供应商与向最终消费者销售产品的垄断中间商进行谈判时，上游合并如何影响协商价格。传统观点认为，当产品对消费者而言是互补品时，此类交易会降低协商价格；而当产品是替代品时，则会提高协商价格。其思路是，消费者需求关系会传导至上游谈判，其中互补品供应商之间的合并会削弱供应商的议价能力，而替代品之间的合并则会增强其议价能力。我对此观点提出质疑，表明当中间商销售的产品超出合并供应商的产品范围时，这一观点不再成立。在这种情况下，合并供应商的产品可能对中间商而言是替代品，即使它们对消费者是互补品；或者对中间商而言是互补品，即使它们对消费者是替代品。这些发现表明，上游混合合并可以在没有排他性行为或垄断化的情况下提高价格，并有助于解释此类合并导致的买方特定价格效应。

articles.title_en: The Dramatic Rise of the New Society Journals in Economics
articles.title_cn: 经济学中新学会期刊的戏剧性崛起
articles.abstract_en: We produce updated rankings of economics journals based on established and new methodologies, and use these rankings to document the spectacular rise of the new society journals in economics. We show that, while several factors (editor reputations, editor experience, citations from parent journals and the number of articles published) help determine these journals’ impact factors, none help explain why the new journals outperform natural comparison journals. However, soliciting top authors connected to the editors can explain their outperformance. We also consider factors such as fast turnaround times, the transfer of referee reports and associations leveraging their reputations.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们基于既有和新方法论生成了经济学期刊的最新排名，并利用这些排名记录了经济学中新学会期刊的显著崛起。我们表明，尽管若干因素（编辑声誉、编辑经验、来自母刊的引用以及发表文章数量）有助于决定这些期刊的影响因子，但没有任何因素能解释为何新期刊优于自然比较期刊。然而，邀请与编辑有联系的顶尖作者可以解释其超越表现。我们还考虑了诸如快速周转时间、审稿报告转移以及协会利用其声誉等因素。

articles.title_en: Climate Shocks, Cyclones and Economic Growth: Bridging the Micro-Macro Gap
articles.title_cn: 气候冲击、飓风与经济增长：弥合微观与宏观之间的鸿沟
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a joint empirical-structural approach to quantify the impacts of cyclone risks on economic growth and welfare. First, we review prior reduced-form approaches in a harmonised global dataset and through a theory lens. Second, we estimate cyclone impacts on structural determinants of growth (total factor productivity, capital losses and fatalities) to quantify a stochastic endogenous growth cyclone-economy model for forty vulnerable countries. Third, we study climate change impacts on cyclone risk. The results suggest negative but mostly modest impacts of risk changes on growth, which may nonetheless add up over time to substantial welfare losses, especially in the Caribbean and the United States.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种联合实证-结构方法，用以量化飓风风险对经济增长和福利的影响。首先，我们在一个统一的全球数据集和理论视角下回顾了先前的简化形式方法。其次，我们估计了飓风对增长结构性决定因素（全要素生产率、资本损失和死亡人数）的影响，以量化针对四十个脆弱国家的随机内生增长飓风-经济模型。第三，我们研究了气候变化对飓风风险的影响。结果表明，风险变化对增长的影响为负但大多温和，然而这些影响可能随时间累积，导致显著的福利损失，尤其是在加勒比地区和美国。

articles.title_en: Towards an Understanding of Reference-Dependent Labour Supply: Theory and Evidence from a Field Experiment
articles.title_cn: 理解参考依赖的劳动供给：来自实地实验的理论与证据
articles.abstract_en: We experimentally study the effects of transitory incentives and income predicted by models of reference-dependent labour supply. Visiting an open-air market in India, we induce experimental variation in: (i) incentives by offering vendors a supplemental wage over the course of two days and (ii) income by, one morning, administering a substantial overpayment for a good sold in the market. We find that incentives have a staggered effect on hours worked: initially vendors do not respond, but by the second day their hours worked increases. In response to the overpayment, we find that both hours worked and a measure of effort are unaffected. Collectively these findings suggest vendors supply their labour according to a model where reference dependence is moderated by experience with an incentive regime or by the time at which income is accumulated.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验研究了参考依赖劳动供给模型所预测的暂时性激励和收入效应。在印度的一个露天市场，我们通过实验诱导变化：(i) 激励，即向摊贩提供为期两天的补充工资；(ii) 收入，即在某天早上，对市场上出售的一种商品进行大额超额支付。我们发现激励对工作时间有交错影响：起初摊贩没有反应，但到第二天，他们的工作时间增加了。对于超额支付，我们发现工作时间和努力程度均未受影响。这些发现共同表明，摊贩根据一个模型来提供劳动，在该模型中，参考依赖受到对激励制度的经验或收入积累时间的调节。

articles.title_en: Patience and Subnational Differences in Human Capital: Regional Analysis with Facebook Interests
articles.title_cn: 耐心与人力资本的次国家差异：基于Facebook兴趣的区域分析
articles.abstract_en: Decisions to invest in human capital depend on people's time preferences. This paper shows that differences in patience are closely related to substantial subnational differences in educational achievement, leading to new perspectives on long-standing within-country disparities. We use social media data—Facebook interests—to construct novel regional measures of patience within Italy and the United States. The approach is first validated with a cross-country analysis of patience and Facebook interests. We then show that patience is strongly positively associated with student achievement across regions in both countries, accounting for three-quarters of the achievement variation across Italian regions and one-third across US states. The finding is confirmed in an identification strategy employing variation in ancestry countries of the current populations of US states. Results hold for six other countries with more limited regional achievement data.
articles.abstract_cn: 人力资本投资决策取决于人们的时间偏好。本文表明，耐心的差异与教育成就的显著次国家差异密切相关，为长期存在的国内差异提供了新视角。我们使用社交媒体数据——Facebook兴趣——来构建意大利和美国境内耐心的新型区域度量。该方法首先通过耐心与Facebook兴趣的跨国分析进行验证。随后，我们证明在两国的各地区中，耐心与学生成就呈强烈正相关，解释了意大利各地区成就变异的四分之三以及美国各州的三分之一。该发现在利用美国各州当前人口祖先来源国变异的识别策略中得到确认。结果在另外六个区域成就数据有限的国家的分析中依然成立。

articles.title_en: On the Post-Enlightenment Evolution of Moral Universalism
articles.title_cn: 论后启蒙时代道德普遍主义的演变
articles.abstract_en: Is humanity’s circle of moral concern expanding? I explore frequencies of morally universal language in 15 million book publications in American English, British English, French, Spanish, German and Italian from 1800–2000. In each language, morally universal terminology diminished markedly. This pattern also emerges in Chinese, Russian and Hebrew books. I test two prominent hypotheses predicting moral universalism, pertaining to reason and religiosity. Reason-based terminology indeed correlates positively with purely morally universal terminology—but also (and more strongly so) with morally communal terminology. These empirical patterns cast doubt on claims of (i) moral universalism expanding and (ii) reason being its main driver.
articles.abstract_cn: 人类的道德关怀圈是否在扩大？我探究了15-1800年间美国英语、英国英语、法语、西班牙语、德语和意大利语中2000万本图书出版物中道德普遍性语言的频率。在每种语言中，道德普遍性术语显著减少。这一模式也出现在中文、俄语和希伯来语书籍中。我检验了两个预测道德普遍主义的著名假说，分别涉及理性与宗教性。基于理性的术语确实与纯粹的道德普遍性术语正相关——但（且更强烈地）与道德社群性术语正相关。这些经验模式对（i）道德普遍主义正在扩大和（ii）理性是其主要驱动力的主张提出了质疑。

excluded_items.title_en: Correction to: The Smoot-Hawley Trade War
